item.title: Schwab Wants to Choose WEF Successor, Says Chairs Fink & Hoffmann Shouldn't Have Conflicts of Interests, Is Tightlipped on Borge-Epstein Connection: Swiss Media
item.description: World Economic Forum (WEF) founder Klaus Schwab tells Swiss media he's exploring ways to choose his successor, that he won't comment further on Borge Brende's connections to Jeffrey Epstein, and that board members like interim co-chairs Larry Fink and Andre Hoffmann shouldn't have conflicts of interests.
